🇺🇸 🇨🇳 ⚡️ - A new report from the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission warns that Beijing is trying to evade American export controls to obtain advanced Nvidia chips for its military's AI weapons programs. The PLA wants to integrate artificial intelligence into weapons, targeting, command systems, and logistics, which China calls "intelligentized warfare." The commission says Chinese alternatives from Huawei and Cambricon still lag behind Nvidia and AMD. Reuters previously identified more than $3 billion in Chinese computing projects using restricted American chips.

Location: Bhinmal, Jalore, Rajasthan Date: October 25 During a Garba event, MLA and former BJP leader T. Raja Singh peddled the anti-Muslim conspiracy theory of “love jihad” and claimed that if Hindus decided to do “jihad”, Muslims would not find any women to marry. He urged Hindu women not to befriend any “non-Hindu”, terming them enemies of the nation and society. He also praised the ban on “non-Hindus” at Garba events and Muslim bouncers, whom he described as “jihadi who cut and eat our cow-mother.” Targeting Amruta Fadnavis for her comments on inclusive festivities, he challenged her to organise a Dandiya night exclusively for Muslim women and Hindu men. He reiterated the demand for a “Hindu Rashtra” and claimed that Hindus would be beheaded the day Narendra Modi’s rule ends. Another speaker raised the slogan, “Be Laxmi, Be Kali; But never be a Burqewali.”
